title: Los años de Menem
goal: Read about the economic and political side of Menem's Argentina -- Cavallo's convertibility plan, the 1994 constitutional reform enabling his 1995 reelection, the risks of an overvalued currency anchor, and the personal style behind his popularity.

items: Describe how convertibility affected inflation and the economy's link to the dollar.
Explain how Menem used the 1994 reform in 1995.
Explain the risks of the overvalued currency anchor: a trade deficit and growing foreign debt.
Describe the personal style Menem used to consolidate his popularity.
Use valerse de to describe using something to one's advantage.
